#!/bin/bash
# Boot Windows 3.11 VM under QEMU with VNC :1 and monitor socket.
set -u
MON=/tmp/qemu-monitor.sock
rm -f "$MON"
exec qemu-system-i386 \
  -M pc \
  -cpu 486 \
  -m 32 \
  -hda /app/isos/win311.img \
  -snapshot \
  -vga cirrus \
  -net none \
  -k en-us \
  -vnc :1 \
  -monitor unix:$MON,server,nowait \
  -serial none -parallel none

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Grab a screendump from the running VM and save it as PNG."""
import subprocess
import sys

from PIL import Image

out = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/tmp/shot.png"
ppm = "/tmp/_shot.ppm"
subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, "/app/qmon.py", "screendump " + ppm],
    check=True,
    stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
)
im = Image.open(ppm).convert("RGB")
im.save(out)
print(out, im.size, im.convert("L").getextrema())

#!/bin/bash
# Web access layer for the VM console.
#   websockify: serves the noVNC client and bridges WebSocket -> VNC :5901
#               on 127.0.0.1:8080, which the stock nginx.conf proxies to :80.
set -u

rm -f /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/novnc

if ! pgrep -f 'websockify.*8080' >/dev/null; then
  setsid nohup websockify --web /usr/share/novnc 8080 127.0.0.1:5901 \
    >/var/log/websockify.log 2>&1 &
  sleep 1
fi

nginx -t
if pgrep -x nginx >/dev/null; then nginx -s reload; else nginx; fi
